view.sqlSentence: SELECT invoice_detail.item, product.name description, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE product.id = item.product AND invoice_detail.item = item.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?,"-",?,"-",1), "%Y-%m-%d"), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?,"-",? + 1,"-",1), "%Y-%m-%d"), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND invoice.type = ? GROUP BY 1,2
